questions.statement: $3x^3+5x^2+5x+3=0$ тэгшитгэл хэдэн ялгаатай бодит шийдтэй вэ?
questions.sourceScaffold: Бодолт: $3x^3+5x^2+5x+3=[a](x^3+1)+[b]x(x+1)=0$ гэдгээс үржигдэхүүн болговол $(x+1)([c]x^2+[d]x+[e])=0$ болох ба эндээс цааш бодвол уг тэгшитгэл $[f]$ ширхэг ялгаатай бодит шийдтэй байна.
questions.pitfall: The cubic factorization leaves a quadratic with no real roots. Stored JSONL has a wrong x^4 and a missing factor.
questions.statementHTML: 3x3+5x2+5x+3=03x^3+5x^2+5x+3=0 тэгшитгэл хэдэн ялгаатай бодит шийдтэй вэ?

stepsHTML: 3(x3+1)+5x(x+1)=(x+1)(3x2+2x+3)=0;D=22−4⋅3⋅3=−32<0;x=−13(x^3+1)+5x(x+1)=(x+1)(3x^2+2x+3)=0;\quad D=2^2-4\cdot3\cdot3=-32<0;\quad x=-1
questions.hint: Номын хоосон нүд бүрийг нөх; үлдсэн квадратын D-ийг шалга.
questions.note: Гуравдугаар зэрэгтэй тэгшитгэл заавал гурван бодит шийдтэй байхгүй.

Эндээс x=[e]x=[e], x=−[f]x=-[f], x=±[g]x=\pm[g] гэсэн шийдүүд олдоно.

sourceIssues.detail: Source asks the difference of roots without naming their order. Positive choices and publisher keys establish the intended value as absolute difference / larger root minus smaller root. Prototype instruction can explain that convention without altering the source prompt.

prototypeGuidance: Use all 15 source questions and their five actual choices in each variant; source time limit is 40 minutes.
All roots are understood in R. Q3 has no real root (negative discriminant); Q4 has one distinct repeated root (zero discriminant).
Q6 and Q7 differ in requested min/max between variants: A6 minimum vs B6 maximum; A7 maximum vs B7 minimum.
Q12 answers are 2±sqrt(2) (A) and 3±sqrt(6) (B). Require both roots when using free response.
Q13 uses fractional coefficients. A asks sum 5/3 (mixed number 1 2/3), B asks sum 7/3 (mixed number 2 1/3).
Q15 grades the nonnegative root difference: A=0.5, B=2.4. Offer the convention larger−smaller explicitly in explanation.
Decimal coefficients are exact terminating decimals; clear denominators or use rational arithmetic.

Teaching sequence: factor monic quadratics; negative/zero/positive discriminants; normalize negative coefficient and move RHS terms; min/max signed comparison; nonmonic factoring and fractions; completing square; Vieta sum; decimal coefficients and root difference.
